title: Higher-Order Cyclotomic Congruences for $q$-Secant and Generalized $q$-Euler Numbers
summary: Let $\A(2n)$ denote the set of up--down alternating permutations of $\{1,2,\ldots,2n\}$, and let \[ E_{2n}(q)=\sum_{σ\in\A(2n)}q^{\operatorname{inv}(σ)}. \] Andrews and Foata proved that $E_{2n}(q)\equiv q^{2n(n-1)}\pmod{(1+q)^2}$, and Liu recently obtained the cubic refinement \[ E_{2n}(q)\equiv q^{2n(n-1)}-\binom n2(1+q)^2 \pmod{(1+q)^3}. \] Using the reciprocal generating function for the $q$-secant numbers, a third-order expansion of Gaussian coefficients at $q=-1$, finite differences, and Newton interpolation, we prove the fourth-order refinement \[ E_{2n}(q)\equiv q^{2n(n-1)}-\binom…
